title: WIRED ICM Sample Dataset - Workshop on Intracranial Recordings in Humans, Epilepsy, DBS

funding_references.award_title: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders

description: A sample intracranial electrophysiology dataset containing recordings from patients with epilepsy during natural listening tasks. The dataset includes evoked responses to movie trailers and speech stimuli (TIMIT corpus), along with examples of seizure-related activity and vagus nerve stimulator artifact. Designed as tutorial material for the WIRED ICM course, this dataset demonstrates clinical iEEG recording techniques and signal processing challenges in human neuroscience research.
methods_description: Intracranial recordings were collected from patients implanted with electrode grids during three listening tasks: movietrailers (Pixar, Disney, and Dreamworks movie clips), timit4 (unique sentences from TIMIT corpus), and timit5 (repeated sentences from TIMIT corpus). Event markers indicate stimulus onset and offset. All procedures were approved by the University of Texas at Austin Institutional Review Board.
